# ix: subfault number along strike direction
# iy: subfault number along dip direction
# Lat: latitude of center of subfault
# Lon: longitude of center of subfault
# Dep: depth of center of subfault (m)
# Lx: subfault length along strike direction (m)
# Ly: subfault length along dip direction (m)
# Area: subfault area (m^2)
# Slip: final slip (m)
# Rake: rake angle for final slip (deg.)
# Ttrg: trigger time of first time window (s)
# TW(itm): slip at "itm"th time window (m)
# rkTW(itm): rake angle for slip at "itm"th time window (deg.)
# itm: time-window number
# ntm: total number of time windows
